row.evidence: BigID's pricing page is quote-only ("Every quote is scoped to the data, AI assistants and agents you need to protect"), and its product documentation sits behind a customer login, so SCIM availability is not publicly documented.
row.notes: New row. BigID (data security, privacy and AI governance) sells Express, Business and Enterprise packages by quote only. The public docs portal exposes only the Cookie Consent guide; the full BigID documentation requires login, and the public developer portal covers REST API authentication (session login or user tokens valid up to 999 days) and data-source/DSAR tutorials but no user-management or SCIM endpoints. The Okta OIN BigID app (2021) is SAML SSO only. No first-party statement on SCIM was found, so status stays unknown.

user_api.notes: A general REST API exists (session or user-token auth), but no user-management endpoints are publicly documented.

okta.notes: OIN page (last updated Jan. 22 2021) marks only SAML (read from page markup).

fallbacks.notes: Full product documentation requires a BigID login.
